author: Bluecichlid
body:
Hello there,

Any staff know if my old map ("Cerius") still exists on the staff build server (or even if that server still exists). IF the server still exists, if you don't mind having a look through the warps and worlds lists, I would appreciate it. I still really like the look of it, shame it was never implemented.

Link: http://old.avicus.net/forums/topic/2645?page=1

Sorry for starting a new thread, put there wasn't really anywhere else to put it...

Thank you!
-Blue
